items.title: Assess literature and reuse before choosing a fragment
items.target: Existing formal judgments and at most three candidate Lab boundaries
items.action: Inspect primary literature and relevant formal artifacts; recommend REUSE, EXTEND, BUILD_SMALL, or STOP.
items.expected_value: Avoid duplicated work and select a tractable bridge to a real assurance question.
items.rank_rationale: Highest eligible value: can change the method and fragment before implementation; existing upstream follow-through has no recorded urgent deadline.
items.entry_gate: Owner-selected planning successor; execution is a read-only assessment under the plan's finite bounds.
items.completion: Dated search log, source/version/claim/gap table, candidate comparison and evidence-backed recommendation under results/research/conditional-validation-contracts/cvc-1/.
items.stop_condition: Decision supported or three sessions exhausted; at most 18 queries, 12 primary sources and six code inspections; zero builds/checker launches.

items.title: State one contract and proof target
items.target: One fragment selected by CVC-1 and at most two strategies
items.action: Fix input meaning, target judgment, assumptions, environment and reconstruction relation; define a finite successor execution protocol.
items.expected_value: Turns a real ambiguity into a precise, challengeable formal question.
items.rank_rationale: First conditional successor if the search supports formal work; smaller and more decisive than broad specification discovery.
items.entry_gate: Successful CVC-1 artifact recommends proceeding; record entry-gate and ranking decision before READY.
items.completion: Formal signature/judgment, exact acceptance obligation, source mappings, positive and negative examples, assumption ledger, and exact proof target/protocol.
items.stop_condition: Two sessions or inability to state a non-circular target; record missing definition/theorem and rerank.

items.title: Prove or refute one preservation claim
items.target: The single CVC-2 contract and pinned formalization
items.action: Reuse/reproduce an existing result or attempt one preservation theorem and its non-vacuous examples.
items.expected_value: Establishes a scoped semantic result or exposes the exact formal obstacle.
items.rank_rationale: Only worth its proof cost after contract/reuse feasibility is demonstrated.
items.entry_gate: CVC-2 succeeds; exact available runtime, assumptions and new-phase execution protocol are bound before attempts.
items.completion: Checked scoped theorem plus exact acceptance-obligation checks, checked counterexample, or bounded unresolved ledger; exact proof dependencies and reproducible commands. Counterexamples retain NEGATIVE outcome and trigger explicit replacement/reranking of theorem-dependent successors.
items.stop_condition: Four sessions or 12 proof builds of at most five minutes each; no new family or broad kernel proof.

items.title: Connect the contract to real validation behavior
items.target: At most two implementation lineages and four fixed pairs
items.action: Map parsing, reconstruction, validation and semantic use; execute only the bound comparison.
items.expected_value: Shows whether the formal result actually explains an ecosystem ambiguity.
items.rank_rationale: Conditional on a usable proof result; speculative adapters or a broad checker survey would have lower value.
items.entry_gate: CVC-3 proves the preservation target with SUCCESS outcome; review preserves scope; finite new-phase launch protocol is valid. A NEGATIVE counterexample requires an explicitly revised or new comparison item rather than satisfying this dependency.
items.completion: Exact bytes, observer profiles, raw outcomes and source-to-contract mapping; explicitly retain any unproved implementation bridge.
items.stop_condition: Three sessions, four pairs or 16 launches of at most 30 seconds; stop on invalid inputs or unresolved adapter boundary.

items.title: Prepare shared evidence and decide the next phase
items.target: The scoped result and the ecosystem target it benefits
items.action: Prepare a regression/formalization/clarification draft or justified no-action result, then compare successor options.
items.expected_value: Converts completed research into a reusable asset and a ranked next action.
items.rank_rationale: Closure is required at every earlier stop; this final packaging item applies only if the full path succeeds.
items.entry_gate: CVC-4 succeeds and contribution still has value; earlier negative/unresolved stops perform closure immediately without waiting for this item.
items.completion: Stand-alone contribution or no-action recommendation plus phase decision and updated ranked queue.
items.stop_condition: Two sessions with existing evidence only; external publication is not part of local completion.

items.title: Check pending Arena dispositions once
items.target: Arena PRs #181 and #182 and deferred Kiota clarification
items.action: Perform one GET-only disposition/duplicate inventory and record any new actionable feedback.
items.expected_value: Closes existing community contributions and may unblock a concrete clarification.
items.rank_rationale: Second eligible item; promote at a stopping boundary if substantive feedback or a deadline makes it more valuable than research.
items.entry_gate: Read-only scope only; run CLI preflight and preserve the existing Kiota deferral.
items.completion: One dated bounded status packet, changed/no-change findings, and recommendation with next check trigger.
items.stop_condition: One session and at most six GET requests after preflight; zero checker launches or external messages; no repeated polling.

items.title: Design the next fixed survivor triage
items.target: One selected member of the seven pending survivors
items.action: Prepare an evidence-based fixed-candidate triage proposal and finite execution manifest.
items.expected_value: Potential small shared regression using existing campaign assets.
items.rank_rationale: Fallback if formal-contract work has poor feasibility or a survivor has stronger concrete evidence.
items.entry_gate: Separate owner authorization for renewed survivor research; selection and manifest precede checker feedback.
items.completion: One exact candidate, evidence rationale, budget and stopping predicate ready for authorization.
items.stop_condition: One planning session; no checker execution under this queue entry.
items.blocked_reason: Outside the selected contract phase; no new survivor campaign is authorized.

items.title: Assess a prospective transfer study
items.target: One independent or held-out transfer question
items.action: Design one falsifiable transfer comparison after reviewing relevant methods and prior knowledge.
items.expected_value: Could test generalization beyond the retrospective single-obligation study.
items.rank_rationale: Lower near-term feasibility and higher dependency cost than a decisive contract/reuse assessment.
items.entry_gate: Separate phase authorization; fresh literature check; independent target and preregistration are prerequisites.
items.completion: Bounded design with frozen comparison, resource estimate, leakage controls and go/no-go recommendation.
items.stop_condition: One design session, no checker execution; stop if independence cannot be established.
items.blocked_reason: Independent successor research remains deferred; not activated by this plan.

items.title: Characterize one materialization blocker
items.target: A specific missing proof or assurance dependency
items.action: If a selected item is blocked, isolate one portability/materialization repair with exact inputs and cost.
items.expected_value: Enables reproduction when a real dependency is missing.
items.rank_rationale: Promote only for an observed blocker; building a general storage service now has weak demonstrated value.
items.entry_gate: A selected item records a concrete missing-input blocker; any network/write permissions remain explicit.
items.completion: Reproduction or repair proposal for one named missing dependency, with a finite implementation budget.
items.stop_condition: One diagnostic session, no checker launches or broad infrastructure build.
items.blocked_reason: No new materialization blocker has been demonstrated for the unexecuted phase.
